summary: Signing inventory options: `automationhub_create_default_collection_signing_service = True`, `automationhub_auto_sign_collections = True`, `automationhub_require_content_approval = True`, plus `automationhub_collection_signing_service_key` and `automationhub_collection_signing_service_script` with absolute paths; uploads must then be signed and approved.
questions: Which inventory variables enable collection signing on hub?
